verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The core operational and failure/recovery flow is especially complete: paging, acknowledgment, triage outcomes, declaration, owner assignment, coordinated mitigation, health-gated resolution, failed-verification retry, and five-minute secondary escalation are all represented.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The board does not explicitly show that the alert is high-confidence; the SaaS-team boundary is also absent, and the incident-record location of the preserved timeline is only implied.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board covers every system-defining requirement and nearly the entire end-to-end incident lifecycle. Gaps are confined to supporting context or qualifiers: SaaS-team scope is absent, high-confidence alerting is absent, lightweightness is implicit rather than stated, and timeline storage in the incident record is partial.
